description: Stage the changes a description names, without committing. Every unstaged hunk and whole file is judged against the instruction; only the matching units are written to the index. The worktree is never modified and no commit is created. Use when the user asks to stage part of a dirty tree (e.g. 'stage the parser fix, not the formatting').
name: git_stage

dry_run.description: Report what would be staged without touching the index.

instruction.description: Natural-language description of the changes to stage. Naming a file, a kind of edit, or a feature is enough.

path.description: Restrict judgment to one file or a directory subtree (repo-relative). Omit to consider every unstaged change.
